name: The name with a wildcard for the middle
when: a person publishes under two or three name forms (a middle name, an initial, none)
shape: "<first> * <last>" — the in-phrase * stands for one word, so one query matches Dylan Riley, Dylan J. Riley and Dylan John Riley
ingredients: the name forms the library holds for the person
yields: the pieces under every form in one query instead of three
misses: a form with two middle words; a hyphenated surname split differently; a name the site prints surname-first
origin: the same query; the Reporter's PERSON HARVEST doctrine keeps the wildcard form whole in the term pool
